from_speaker: OpenAI couldn't afford to pay Oracle
Oracle didn't have the capacity to service
our_interpretation: Assess the financial and delivery position as of September 12, 2025.

Affordability means resources and committed financing sufficient for scheduled payments, accounting for other obligations. It does not require holding the entire five-year contract value in cash immediately.
Capacity means the ability, established at the assessment date, to supply the services when contractually required. Distinguish existing operating capacity from planned construction.
Treat the two assertions separately; evidence for one does not establish the other.
The reported contract value is an estimate from press reporting. The five-year term is a service duration, not a deadline for this retrospective observation.
criteria.support_condition: Contract schedules and contemporaneous records establish both insufficient financial resources for the required payments and insufficient deliverable capacity for the required services.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contract schedules and contemporaneous records establish adequate funding and deliverable capacity. Opposing findings for the two components would support a mixed assessment.
